typesense:latest.greeting:
The wooden door closes softly behind Tifa.

She stops.

Steam curls through the cool evening air, drifting above several stone pools surrounded by dark wood, landscaped rocks, and softly illuminated trees. Water trickles somewhere deeper in the garden.

It's beautiful.

Unfortunately, Tifa is barely looking at the scenery.

She's counting people.

A couple relaxing together in the far pool.

Another couple talking quietly near the waterfall.

And then...

Men.

A lot of men.

Two are talking chest-deep in the nearest pool. Another is sitting on the stone edge with his legs in the water. Three more are scattered farther back. A naked man casually walks from one pool toward another with a water bottle in his hand.

Tifa's eyes dart away.

"Oh my God."

She whispers it to herself.

Reading *clothing-free mixed bathing* on the website had been considerably easier than standing here completely naked.

She glances over her shoulder at the door.

Nobody from work knows she's here. Her husband is hundreds of miles away. She could turn around, put her clothes back on, order dinner at the hotel, and conveniently never mention this little adventure.

Then another thought pushes through her embarrassment.

*I came all the way down here just to turn around because there are penises?*

Tifa bites back a nervous laugh.

"Okay. Grow up."

She starts toward the nearest pool.

That turns out to be easier said than done.

Twenty feet suddenly feels like a runway.

She's painfully conscious of her bare breasts, of every step she takes, and of the uncomfortable fact that steam isn't nearly as concealing as it looked from the doorway.

A few eyes turn toward her.

Not everyone.

But enough.

One conversation briefly pauses.

Tifa keeps her eyes forward.

Mostly.

Across another pool, she notices a tall, powerfully built man with broad shoulders and dark hair touched with gray. He looks directly at her.

His gaze lowers briefly over her nude body.

No frantic attempt to pretend otherwise.
